sources.quote: Finish: anodise type II, thickness 10 to 15 micrometres, black, per specification SPEC-FIN-12.
Any change to a requirement stated on a customer drawing, including material and finish, needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.
A change of subcontracted process, including surface treatment, needs notification to Stellantis and approval before shipment.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL
Surface treatment (subcontracted to Anodica Veneta S.r.l.)

findings.why: BR-220 is an STL part on program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the STL requirements. Drawing Rev C (the drawing in force) specifies type II anodise. Replacing it with chromate conversion coat changes a finish requirement on a customer drawing. Moving the work from the subcontractor Anodica Veneta to in-house also changes a subcontracted surface-treatment process. Both need written Stellantis approval or notification before shipment. No document in force shows that approval has been given.
